tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Minimal inhibitory concentrations (MICs) and minimum bactericidal concentrations (MBCs) of tilapia piscidin 4 (TP4) and antibiotics tested on clinical isolates of bacterial vaginosis (BV)-associated bacteria and vaginal lactobacilli.
footnotes: X, no biofilm formation ability; O, able to form biofilm.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Comparative susceptibility of Gardnerella vaginalis, Candida albicans, and vaginal lactobacilli to TP4 and antibiotics.
footnotes: MR: spontaneous metronidazole-resistant mutant; O: able to form biofilm.
